scope: all D* and all three channel variants

quotas.initial_pending_write: excluded on the good initial event; qualification not claimed
quotas.fixed_competitor_quotas: rho0 + delta_exec + delta_svc; no unnecessary monitor/statistical quota

mark_contract.parents: exogenous marked NHPP; marks independent across parents; multiword marks allowed
mark_contract.position_law: time-invariant conditional bit-position distribution in each word, for non-SMU touches
mark_contract.D_star_full38_direct_exposure_upper: variable prescribed axis D*, never optimized downward
mark_contract.Dstar_meaning: E[number of parents touching >=2 positions of at least one full word / mission]

application_contract.price: expected occupied common-bus time through T, including after hidden failure

quiet_return_example.status: additional price-only contract, not inferred from fluence; initial portions of quiet intervals remain in the metric

service.calendar: g chosen per witness; paired layout; inverse ka modulo W; ka odd

quiet_control_profile.status: declared mathematical profile, not REM/SREM or a qualified instrument
quiet_control_profile.quiet_mean_contract: w_upper*(a_M*b_nom+eta); original quiet class, no zero-solar assumption
quiet_control_profile.solar_b_U: bbar as an explicit conditional bound on ALL invisible load
quiet_control_profile.delivery_compute_upper: grid d seconds; budget enlarged by margin and quantized
quiet_control_profile.window_interface: cumulative counter/subwindow counts at stride w/2, sufficient integer range
quiet_control_profile.saturation: none in declared Lambda under the diagnostic lower/upper contracts; unqualified physically
quiet_control_profile.spectral_domain: abstract full load nu or declared visible part; no flight response inferred
quiet_control_profile.resource_scope: same conservative combined envelope retained separately for each mode
quiet_control_profile.global_quotas: inherit each old set; omit only unused ERR or monitor quotas as T80 specifies

singleton_diagnostic.status: additional singleton/equal-load model; not physical MCU qualification

note: window/lease and resources are recomputed at selected g; source older monitor fields are not substituted
